Dear ImGui 1.92.8 subset for Orbeden.

Included:
- Core ImGui files: imgui.cpp, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_tables.cpp, imgui_widgets.cpp and required headers.
- GLFW platform backend: backends/imgui_impl_glfw.*
- OpenGL3 renderer backend: backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.* plus Orbeden wrapper that uses engine GLAD2.
- Vulkan renderer backend: backends/imgui_impl_vulkan.* for future Vulkan support. Not compiled until Vulkan is integrated.
- std::string helper: misc/cpp/imgui_stdlib.*
- LICENSE.txt

Not included:
- examples/
- docs/
- fonts/
- freetype helper
- platform-specific renderer backends other than OpenGL3/Vulkan
